description: Ouragan displayed nose-up on stilts in a traffic roundabout at the end of runway 24 at Kumbhirgram, wearing the fake serial IC-222 (true identity unknown), canopy replaced by aluminium sheet, nose gear missing. Source warbirds.in (Dipalay Dey, 2015).
Green-painted Mi-4 titled Vanguards preserved outside the No.110 HU technical area at Kumbhirgram; serial not recorded. Source warbirds.in (2015; EAC photo Oct 2022).
Mi-8 Z1366 listed by the bharat-rakshak database as preserved at Kumbhirgram AFS. Not independently verified.
